text: Keratin and chitin are two important biological molecules. Keratin is found in hair, fur and skin.
Chitin is a modified polysaccharide found in a number of different organisms, for example in
fungal cell walls and the hard outer skeletons of insects.

sloth have grooves in them where water can collect.

sloth’s fur, the most common species being Trichophilus welckeri. Algae are eukaryotic,
